title: Official OTS ConvIR-B local paired-GT error measurement on SOTS-Outdoor
rationale: The asset audit qualified one exact official OTS checkpoint and one complete SOTS-Outdoor copy. This route is not a retry of the failed OTS tau claim: it changes the target domain, baseline identity and measurement target, using paired hazy-to-GT tile error rather than depth times beta. It evaluates all 500 hazy variants nested within 492 clear-source groups, requires global model competence, and tests a model-output-independent local correction imbalance against a 180-degree spatial rotation control. The result is development-screening diagnostic evidence only; SOTS cannot later be relabeled as unseen confirmation evidence.

scientific_contract.question: Across the 492 independent SOTS-Outdoor clear-source groups, does the fixed official OTS ConvIR-B baseline show a material paired-GT local restoration mismatch in which high-input-error regions receive weaker relative correction than low-input-error regions, beyond a within-image rotated spatial control?

intervention.reference: paired hazy input versus clear GT, with true input-error regions compared against the same tile-error field rotated 180 degrees within image
intervention.matched_budget: all 500 hazy variants nested within exactly 492 clear-source groups; one fixed official checkpoint; zero training or model selection
fixed_factors: all 492 GT images and all 500 paired hazy images are used at original resolution with no scientific-data resizing
official Dehazing.OTS build_net('base') is strictly loaded from checkpoint state_dict['model']; input is reflect-padded to a multiple of 32 and model(input)[2] is cropped and clipped to [0,1]
pixel input and output errors are mean RGB squared errors against paired clear GT
local rankings use non-overlapping 32 by 32 error tiles after reflection padding only the error maps to a multiple of 32
true low and high regions are the exact bottom and top 20 percent of tile input error with stable row-major tie breaking
regional relative correction is (mean input error minus mean output error) divided by mean input error plus 1e-8
the negative control rotates the tile input-error score field 180 degrees before forming regions while leaving input and output errors spatially fixed
a source group is a mismatch when its variant-mean true low-minus-high correction is at least 0.10 and its variant-mean true-minus-control imbalance is at least 0.05
multiple hazy variants are averaged within their clear-source group before the group indicator; variants, tiles and pixels are never independent samples
missing or failed source groups remain visible and prevent a definitive PASS or FAIL

primary_estimand.metric: proportion of 492 independent clear-source groups meeting both frozen correction-imbalance and rotated-control-separation margins
primary_estimand.aggregation: source-group binary indicator with two-sided Wilson 95 percent interval

controls: strict identity-bound official OTS checkpoint and official production graph
full-image input-to-output MSE improvement as a global-competence prerequisite
paired GT defines tile degradation before and independently of model output
within-image 180-degree tile-score rotation as a marginal-score-preserving spatial negative control
all hazy variants nested and averaged within the original clear-source group

uncertainty.method: two-sided Wilson 95 percent intervals over 492 independent clear-source groups; variants, tiles and pixels remain nested

gates.estimand: parent authorization, checkpoint, model sources, complete SOTS pairing and aggregate dataset identity match
independent source groups with every paired variant and finite inference
Wilson lower 95 percent bound for source groups whose variant-mean full-image output MSE is below input MSE
Wilson interval for paired-GT local mismatch prevalence with the rotated-control margin embedded in every group indicator

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: Paired input-to-GT error can include scene texture, color, compression or alignment effects and is not a pure haze-density label. Relative correction also shares its denominator with region selection. The within-image rotated control and global-competence prerequisite reduce, but do not eliminate, these explanations. Passing would establish only a descriptive SOTS-domain behavior of this fixed model, not a causal haze mechanism or proof that a new module will help.
disabled_actions: training, fine-tuning, module insertion, loss selection, threshold tuning or candidate selection during this route
using model output to define input-error regions or source groups
treating paired input error as a pure haze-density label or treating spatial association as causal mechanism evidence
treating SOTS outcomes as strict unseen-source generalization because clear-source overlap with OTS training is not excluded
relabeling SOTS as confirmation or sealed-final evidence after this development-screening use
Haze4K outcome, NH-HAZE, confirmation, canary or locked-test access
changing image membership, preprocessing, grouping, metrics, margins, controls or terminal rules after outcomes

precision_contract.rationale: All 492 source groups exceed the 475 groups required for a worst-case two-sided 95 percent binomial-proportion half-width of 0.045.

capability.production_path_statement: The exact official Dehazing.OTS build_net('base') graph strictly loads the official OTS checkpoint and executes the production reflect-pad-to-32, model(input)[2], crop, clip, paired-GT tile metric and result-finalizer path on one synthetic CUDA tensor without scientific data.

precision.source_reference: The asset audit established 492 independent clear-source groups; ceil(1.96^2*0.25/0.045^2)=475.
